data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'houn', meaning 'grace, beauty, charm'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic culture as it symbolizes the divine attributes of Allah. The name Hounia carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty, Charm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hounia usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, charm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
